---
title: "Jaeyoung Yoon"
---

I am a mathematician working in dynamical systems, collective dynamics, kinetic equations, and related problems in applied analysis.

I will join the Department of Mathematics at Konkuk University as a tenure-track faculty member in September 2026.

My research interests include:

- Collective dynamics
- Dynamical systems on networks
- Mathematical aspects of machine learning dynamics
- Consensus-based optimization

For my publications, see [Publications](publications.qmd).
